name: Husbands Love Your Wife
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a divine institution designed for companionship and unity, as God created a suitable helper for man and established that a husband and wife become one flesh. Husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, emulating Christ's love for the church, while wives are instructed to submit to their husbands as to the Lord. This mutual relationship is grounded in kindness, tenderheartedness, and forgiveness, reflecting the character of God and His redemptive work through Christ.
